title: Cap. 5 Mem. 2 Objections: Adversaries’ charges opened against Huber’s restitution claim
pass_a_gloss: Now the things which can be objected by adversaries, let them be brought into the midst, and briefly dissipated (dissipentur). For the Huberian sentence (sententia Huberiana), which posits that all humans, by this very fact that Christ died for humans, have been restored into the state of grace and salvation, arguments of this kind are brought forward.
pass_b_english: Now let us bring forward the objections our adversaries can raise, and briefly dispose of them.
In defence of Huber's position—that every human being is already restored to the state of grace and salvation simply because Christ died for humankind—arguments of the following kind are advanced.
source_text:
Jam quae objici possunt ab adversariis, in medium afferantur, & paucis dissipentur.

Pro sententia Huberiana, quae ponit omnes homines, hoc ipso quod Christus pro hominibus mortuus est, in statum gratiae & salutis esse restitutos, hujusmodi argumenta afferuntur.
